name: Dingir
source:
Year 1014 by local calendar. 
Peaceful life is interrupted by betrayal and assassination in the court. Dying king conveys main character Baal the prophecy and asks him to try and save the endangered world. Girl As suddenly appears before Baal and agrees to help him on the journey to the Tower of Judgment. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
依當地曆法，這一年是1014年。
宮廷中的背叛與暗殺打破了平靜的生活。彌留之際，國王將預言告知主角Baal，並託他想辦法拯救這個岌岌可危的世界。名叫As的女孩突然出現在Baal面前，答應協助他踏上前往審判之塔的旅程。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
